faq.title: Image to image AI: questions answered

definition.question: What is an image to image AI generator?
definition.answer: It creates a new image using an existing image and a written instruction. You can ask for changes to a background, lighting, objects, or visual style. The reference guides the result, while the selected model and settings affect how the instruction is interpreted.

free.question: Can I use image to image AI for free?
free.answer: Eligible guests can try one free image edit with MiniMax H3 1K or Nano Banana 2 Lite 1K when the sponsored queue is available. The result is private, watermarked, and available for up to 24 hours. Eligible registered accounts receive 10 credits once for two MiniMax H3 Image 1K generations, with no monthly refill. Premium image models and higher resolutions require an active paid subscription when using credits. The USD 2.99 image pack includes 3 successful images with the covered image models and sizes, without a subscription.

control.question: Will the result keep every detail of my original image?
control.answer: Exact preservation is not guaranteed. State which details matter, keep the requested change specific, and compare the result with your original. Faces, lettering, logos, and fine edges may need another edit or manual review.

privacy.question: Are my uploaded images and results public?
privacy.answer: Your reference images and results stay private rather than appearing in a public gallery. Guest media is temporary. Account media follows the retention and deletion rules described in the privacy policy.

limits.question: Can I change the style without a fixed template?
limits.answer: Yes. Describe the style in your prompt instead of selecting from a fixed template list. Content safety, legal requirements, model capabilities, upload limits, and usage allowances still apply.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions

restrictions.question: How does prompt-based photo editing work?
restrictions.answer: Use flexible prompt editing to describe what to preserve and what to change. Keep your images private and review credits before confirming. Content safety checks, legal requirements, model capabilities, and plan limits still apply.

guestAvailability.question: When is the guest edit available?
guestAvailability.answer: Eligible guests can try one free image edit with MiniMax H3 1K or Nano Banana 2 Lite 1K when the sponsored queue is available. The result is private, watermarked, and available for up to 24 hours. Upload a reference image and describe your change. This is a one-time trial in this browser, subject to regional eligibility. Text-to-image generation requires sign-in.

guestVsFree.question: What is the difference between Guest and Free?
guestVsFree.answer: Eligible guests can try one free image edit with MiniMax H3 1K or Nano Banana 2 Lite 1K when the sponsored queue is available. The result is private, watermarked, and available for up to 24 hours. Eligible registered accounts receive 10 credits once for two MiniMax H3 Image 1K generations, with no monthly refill. Premium image models and higher resolutions require an active paid subscription when using credits. The USD 2.99 image pack includes 3 successful images with the covered image models and sizes, without a subscription. Images generated with account credits have no guest watermark and a 30-day retention target. Download results you want to keep.

editTiers.question: Which image models and output settings are available?
editTiers.answer: Explore GPT Image, Nano Banana, and Seedream models. Each model page includes creative directions and prompts. The workspace shows current availability, output settings, and credits before you confirm a generation. Each confirmed generation produces one image.

creditReservation.question: When are credits used?
creditReservation.answer: For account edits, credits are reserved when you confirm the job. The immutable credit ledger charges or returns them when the job reaches its final state; if service acceptance is uncertain, the reservation stays in place until recovery settles the same attempt.

failedEdits.question: What happens to credits when an edit fails?
failedEdits.answer: Technical failures with no usable result release reserved credits. Sensitive-content rejections by the generation provider after submission use the full quoted credits, including the first rejection, without using the output-review waiver. For images returned and then blocked by our safety check, each account or team gets one lifetime waiver; later blocks use the quoted amount. Prompts or uploads stopped before submission cost no generation credits. Uncertain outcomes keep credits reserved until recovery resolves them.

privateUploads.question: Are uploaded images public?
privateUploads.answer: No. Guest and account inputs and outputs are private, not posted to a public gallery. The configured retention target for account inputs and outputs is 30 days. EzImageAI may send only the minimum content needed to configured infrastructure and image-processing services.

formats.question: Do I need to upload a reference image?
formats.answer: No. Sign in to generate from a text prompt with no reference. If you want to edit or guide an existing image, upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Guest reference uploads are limited to 10 MB; account upload limits are shown on the pricing page.

outputBehavior.question: Will every result be unique and exact?
outputBehavior.answer: No. Results can contain defects or resemble other images. EzImageAI does not guarantee uniqueness, fitness for a particular purpose, or freedom from third-party rights.

stableTiers.question: Why do image models use different EzImageAI Credit amounts?
stableTiers.answer: Each image model has its own legal output-setting matrix and EzImageAI Credit amount. EzImageAI shows the product name, supported settings, and exact charge; private service routing and operating costs stay on the server.

annualBilling.question: How does annual billing affect credits?
annualBilling.answer: New annual Pro/Ultimate/Max: $114/$294/$474 each year—50% off 12 monthly payments. Monthly credits: 700/1,800/3,000, with no rollover. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

cancelSubscription.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: Open Billing to manage cancellation. When access changes depends on the actual status and end date reported for your subscription.

refundPolicy.question: How are refunds handled?
refundPolicy.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the payment terms, transaction status, and applicable law. Contact support for review; EzImageAI does not promise a refund where one does not apply.

commercialUse.question: Can I use edited images commercially?
commercialUse.answer: Before commercial use, you must have the rights to every input and independently check the applicable terms, law, and third-party rights. Guest results are temporary and watermarked; EzImageAI does not claim that any output is automatically cleared for commercial use.

quickStartPrompts.restorePhoto: Restore this old photograph. Remove scratches, dust, creases and fading, recover clear natural detail, and gently colorize black-and-white areas with realistic skin tones and period-appropriate colors. Preserve every person's identity, age, expression, clothing and the original composition. Keep a natural photographic texture.
quickStartPrompts.birthdayCard: Create a playful birthday photo card starring the person or pet in the reference photo. Preserve their recognizable face and features. Add a small party hat, a pink birthday cake with three candles, lavender and warm yellow confetti, and a soft pastel background. Use a joyful editorial photography style with natural light and a clear focal subject. Add the words "Happy Birthday!" in clean, easy-to-read lettering. Leave comfortable space around the subject.
quickStartPrompts.watercolor: Reinterpret this image as a soft watercolor illustration. Keep the main subject, composition, and color palette, and add subtle paper texture.
quickStartPrompts.vintagePhoto: Restyle the uploaded portrait as a family-album photograph inspired by the 1980s. Preserve the facial structure, skin tone, apparent age and relaxed closed-mouth expression. Dress the person in a simple knit sweater in a modest living room. Use gentle bounced-flash lighting, warm indoor tones, mild print fading and fine film grain. Keep natural eyes and skin texture, without red-eye, scratches, text or watermarks.
